steps.label: [len] 读回（含长度、字节与存储类）
steps.sql: SELECT id, tag, code IS NULL AS is_null, length(code) AS chars, length(cast(code AS blob)) AS bytes, typeof(code) AS cls FROM probe_check_len ORDER BY id

steps.label: [len] DDL 原样
steps.sql: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='probe_check_len'

rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE probe_check_len (
  id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  tag  TEXT,
  code varchar(24) CHECK (length(code) <= 24)
)
